sent.title: VoIP Engineer
sent.cover_letter:
I am a Telecommunications Analyst with five years of experience supporting IP‑telephony environments, currently at Método Telecom. My daily work includes SIP and RTP protocol analysis, SBC troubleshooting, and provisioning of IP phones and ATAs within BroadWorks deployments—activities that align directly with the design, implementation, and maintenance responsibilities of the VoIP Engineer role.

I have extensive hands‑on experience diagnosing audio issues, SIP registration problems, NAT/firewall interactions, and codec mismatches, using Wireshark for packet capture and CDR/SIP log analysis. This background equips me to monitor VoIP performance, resolve latency, jitter, and packet‑loss incidents, and optimize network quality of service in mission‑critical settings.

My responsibilities also involve direct technical coordination with carriers such as Oi, Algar, and TIP, and managing tier‑2 service tickets under strict incident‑response procedures. These interactions have honed my ability to collaborate with network and infrastructure teams to ensure seamless communication services.

I am available for an interview at your convenience and can contribute immediately to MicroSourcing’s VoIP engineering initiatives.

sent.title: Analista de telecomunicações JR
sent.cover_letter:
I am a Telecommunications Analyst with five years of experience in IP‑telephony environments, currently supporting BroadWorks and VoIP services at Método Telecom. My daily work includes provisioning IP devices, configuring SBCs, and performing SIP/RTP analysis with Wireshark to resolve signaling and media issues in mission‑critical contexts.

I have extensive hands‑on experience troubleshooting SBCs and voice gateways, manipulating SIP headers, and creating routing rules that align closely with the responsibilities for configuring Khomp and Aligera equipment. Direct technical interactions with carriers such as Oi and TIP have sharpened my ability to integrate SIP routes and manage NAP configurations reliably.

My routine includes CDR and SIP log analysis, packet capture interpretation, and diagnosing NAT, firewall, and codec problems (including G.711/G.729). These skills translate directly to the required analysis of SIP/RTP traffic, dial‑plan management, and integration with contact‑center platforms.

I am available for a remote interview at your convenience and look forward to discussing how my background can contribute to Stefanini’s telecom solutions.

Estamos empenhados em criar impacto positivo não apenas nos negócios, mas também na vida de nossos colaboradores. Se você procura uma oportunidade de crescimento profissional em uma empresa que valoriza inovação, respeito, autonomia e parceria, você encontra aqui! Junte-se a nós e seja parte da mudança! Home office - horário comercial Responsabilidades e atribuições Configurar e manter plataformas de telefonia baseadas em Asterisk (planos de discagem/dialplan, troncos, rotas de entrada e saída, URAs e gerenciamento de áudios). Administrar e configurar SBCs e Gateways de voz (Khomp e Aligera), incluindo criação de NAPs, manipulação de cabeçalhos SIP e regras de roteamento. Realizar homologação e integração de rotas SIP com operadoras de telecomunicações. Diagnosticar e solucionar falhas de sinalização, mídia e rede em ambiente Linux. Analisar tráfego e capturas de pacotes com Wireshark para identificar gargalos em fluxos SIP e RTP. Requisitos Técnicos Conhecimento prático em plataformas Asterisk e integração com sistemas de Contact Center. Domínio de protocolos e conceitos de voz sobre IP e redes: SIP, RTP, VoIP, TCP/IP, TLS, DNS, NAT e codecs (G.711, G.729, Opus). Conhecimento em troncos digitais E1 (sinalizações R2D e ISDN). Vivência com SBCs (Khomp) e Gateways (Aligera). Experiência com ferramentas de análise de tráfego (Wireshark) e leitura de logs de sinalização. Conhecimentos básicos a intermediários no sistema operacional Linux para troubleshooting de serviços e conectividade. 🍛 Vale-alimentação ou vale-refeição; 👨🏼 🎓 Desconto em cursos, universidades e institui
